# vote

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m uikit docs` from contracts/vote.json - do not edit by hand. -->

Screen of a vote: question, choices with live counts, countdown, clicks. Per player. Takes the mouse.

C#: `VoteLayout / IVoteService`

Marker: `<!-- uikit:vote choices=5 -->`

Pool parameters (marker and C# layout descriptor must agree):

- `choices` (default `5`): Choice buttons per page (VoteLayout.Choices). A longer vote is paged.

Placeholders: `{n}` = each of `choices`.

| Element | Kind | Required | Kit writes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id="vt_screen"` | panel | yes | `show`, `locked`, `no-close`, `no-pager`, `style-*` | The screen. Style = accent colour, `locked` once the vote takes no more clicks, `no-close` hides the close button, `no-pager` hides the pager (one page). |
| `id="vt_kicker"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the kicker, `empty` when blank. |
| `id="vt_close"` | button | yes | click | Close button (click). Hide it under `no-close`. |
| `id="vt_prev"` | button | yes | `disabled` | Previous page (click), `disabled` on the first page. |
| `id="vt_next"` | button | yes | `disabled` | Next page (click), `disabled` on the last page. |
| `id="vt_choice_{n}"` | button | yes | `hidden`, `style-*`, `selected`, `leading` | A choice (click). Author it `hidden`. `selected` = the viewer's pick, `leading` = most votes. Slot n of the current page. |
| `id="vt_choice_{n}_sub"` | panel | no | `empty` | Second line of a choice, `empty` when blank. |
| `id="vt_choice_{n}_fill"` | panel | no | `p-N` | Bar of a choice: `p-0`..`p-20`, 5 % steps. Use `clip`, not `width`. |
| `text="{s:vt_title}"` | Label text | yes | string | VoteOptions.Title |
| `text="{s:vt_kicker}"` | Label text | no | string | VoteOptions.Kicker |
| `text="{s:vt_time}"` | Label text | no | string | Countdown, VoteOptions.TimeFormat |
| `text="{s:vt_total}"` | Label text | no | string | Votes in all, VoteOptions.TotalFormat |
| `text="{s:vt_page}"` | Label text | no | string | Page, "1 / 2" |
| `text="{s:vt_choice_{n}_label}"` | Label text | yes | string | VoteChoice.Label |
| `text="{s:vt_choice_{n}_sub}"` | Label text | no | string | VoteChoice.Sub |
| `text="{s:vt_choice_{n}_count}"` | Label text | no | string | VoteChoice.Votes |
| `text="{s:vt_choice_{n}_pct}"` | Label text | no | string | Share of the votes, as a percentage |
| `text="{s:vt_<key>}"` | Label text | no | string | VoteOptions.Texts[key] |

Stylesheet should define: `.show`, `.hidden`, `.empty`, `.locked`, `.no-close`, `.no-pager`, `.disabled`, `.selected`, `.leading`, `.style-neutral`, `.style-info`, `.style-success`, `.style-warn`, `.style-danger`.
